tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs grol ba'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī he badz+ra sā dha ka muk+ta ti la ka nā maḥ bod skad du/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs grol ba'i thig le zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal stobs kyi mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med dbang sngon lhun po'i sku/ /dmar ser mtshams sprin ral pa'i cod pan dang / /zla tshes gzhon nu'i thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /khyab bdag he ru ka dpal gang der 'dud/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung gi gsang chen las/ rab zab thabs shes gnyis med brgyud pa'i srol/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gang gi bzhed pa'i gzhung / /rgyas min snying po'i sgrub thabs 'di ltar bri/ /dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs la rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bka' srol rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi dgongs pas/ mngon par rtogs pa lha'i bskyed chog mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas rnam pa bcu bzhi tsam snang ba las/ 'dir sa bon las bskyed pa ltar bshad na/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang / ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ rang nyid stan bde ba la rdo rje dkyil mo dkrung gi 'dug nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rtsa ba'i bla ma kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa/ de'i rgyab tu lung rtogs kyi rang bzhin chos po ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu/ na bza' sku chings dang bcas pa/ de dag gis mtha' skor du pad 'dab la/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin lha mo brgyad bzhugs pa/ rang gi mtha' skor du pha mas gtso byas rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnasa'aphags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshar bdun/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dge 'dun dkon mchog 'od zer dkar por zhu nas rang gi dpral bar thim/ chos dkon mchog 'od zer dmar por zhu nas rang gi mgrin par thim/ gtso bo sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang bla ma kun 'dus kyi rang bzhin 'od zer sngon por zhu nas rang gi snying khar thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal kye rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ bdag gi spyi bor pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i pang na/ yum rdo rje snye ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud brtsi'i rgyun babs pas yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud/ yum gyi pad mar babs pas/ yum gyi sku gang yab yum gnyis char gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos gang bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ shī badz+ra he ru ka sogs nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang skad cig gi kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje'i can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'dam tshogs nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i phyag gi drangs mdzad de/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mora'adud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/

/ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mnyes byas te/ /khyed ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun brgyan nas/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can sad mdzad ma/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyi dgyes/ /tshar re/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /tshar gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/

/rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa las/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu phan tshun chags sdang med par gyur cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ go skabs med pa/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de dbus dang phyogs bcur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/

dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ ser po gzhan thams cad du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og gi khro bo rnams rab tu brjid cing khros pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul 'bum gyis brgyan cing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ khro bo gzhan rnams 'dzum khro dbu skra nag po rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi sham thabs can thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros khro bo bcu gcig srung 'khor dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang /

dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od 'phros khro bo rnams dang / 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer me mdag lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams bsregs shing / lhag ma rnams dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol du bskrad de bar chad bral bar gyur/ hūm̐ ci rigs bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos bzhi la drug las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' rten pa/ de las de 'dra ba'i sems snang chad 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang / sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang / drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shus brgyan cing dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang /

de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su phub pa/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ dur khrod brgyad/ shing brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro/ ro dang ro langs/ 'dre dang / srin po/ sha za'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud tshangs pa ser po/ phung po'i bdud dbang po dkar po/ lha'i bu'i bdud nye dbang sngon po/ 'chi bdag gi bdud drag po nag po/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i steng du/ shar du tshangs pa/ lhor dbang po/ nub tu nye dbang / byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje/ shar lhor nor bdag lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nī la ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su chags pa'i yan lag ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo sogs 'og 'bras bu'i skabs bzhin de'i pang na aṃ las yum rdo rje bdag med ma nas bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ da dā tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da ya ka kha ga mu ṣai ka ra swā nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/

yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs dkar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ/ baṃ/ ghaṃ/ paṃ/ shaṃ laṃ/ ḍaṃ rnams su gyur pa phyir thon/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du lha mo rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar du gau ri nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau ri dmar mo g.yas ḍa ma ru/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai ta li ser mo/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma ri ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa/ byang shar du puk+ka si sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra sta/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon 'khar gsil/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol/ nub byang du g.yung mo ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras bar snang gi yig 'bru lnga yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thig ler gyur pa yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mtshams ma bzhis bskul bar bsam zhing / rje btsun snying rjes yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka si ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gums pas/ /kyai rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/

/ri khrod ma 'bras 'grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal na/ /gdol ba mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyed kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /zhes bskul bas thig le de hūm̐ aṃ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba la 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ rgyab zhal bzhi pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing / spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i/ g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskums/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig

phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ lha mo rnams kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du/ aṃ/ gaṃ tsaṃ/ baṃ/ ghaṃ/ paṃ/ shaṃ/ laṃ/ ḍaṃ rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can la phog pas lha dgu lha rnams kyi dbang po'i gnas rnams stong par gyur pa las mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dwaṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying khar naṃ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la dkyil dkrung bcas pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri ā kar+ṣa ya dza/ tsau ri prā be sha ya hūm̐/ bai ta li ban+dha baṃ/ ghasma ri wa sh+yaṃ ku ru ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/

dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi byang sems brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas spyi gtsug nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing sangs rgyas rigs lngas bum pa'i chus smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang du brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdo 'dzin mgon/ /chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang byin rlabs sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya/

spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po'i phyag rgya/ chu rgyun des snying kha yan chad gang / yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /snying khar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgoms pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau ri dang / puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tsau ri dang shā ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai ta li dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍoṃ bi ni la 'od dpag med pas dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod dngos su bshams pa'am med na yid kyis bsam ste/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gtso 'khor thams cad kyis zhal du myang bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi snying kha nas hūm̐ las sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bsam ste/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ /drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par mos nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor te bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/

/gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rkang pa dkyil dkrung du gnas pas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying kha'i stod du bsdams la/ sna bug g.yas g.yon dbus la dmigs te/ rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar la/ rtsa dbu ma sngo skya g.yas su ro ma dmar mo kha gyen du blta ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po kha 'og tu blta ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba/ dbu ma'i ma snar aṃ dmar po nang skor 'dab ma brgyad/ la/ a/ ka/ tsa/ ṭa/ ta/ pa/ ya/ sha/ phyi skor la mdun nas g.yon skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ tshar gnyis/ mdun nas g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa/ yi ge rnams dmar po mgo bo gyen bstan snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su dbu ma'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po/ mdun nas phyogs bzhir g.yas skor du/ bh+rūm̐/ aṃ/ dzṛṃ/ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ rnams sngo skya mgo thur bstan/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba dbu ma'i nang du oṃ/ 'dab ma rnams la ā li bcu drug dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar po/ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas ā li bcu drug g.yon skor du kā li/ ka nas ta'i bar rnams dkar po mgo thur bstan/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdor me gru gsum bsam/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum byas pa'i mtha' ma la bsdams pas/ bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar bas/ lte ba'i aṃ 'bar ba'i me lce glog gi gzer ma lta bu/ g.yas ro ma nas gyen du song / snying kha'i rtsa 'dab nang gi khams kyi snyigs ma rnams bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song /

mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi snyigs ma bcom/ ro ma nas gyen la song ste me lce spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ haṃ bzhu zhing byang chub kyi sems 'od dkar po'i rnam par bab pa/ g.yon rkyang ma nas thur du song ste/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang zhing rgyas/ yang thur du song nas snying kha'i 'khor lo gang bar byas/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma nas yar song / snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / mgrin pa'i oṃ gyi khams snyigs bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas byang chub kyi sems cher bab pa/ dbu ma'i nang nas song / oṃ dang hūm̐ gsos btab/ lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam du byang sems 'bab pa dang / me lce 'bar ba gnyis skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad/ gsal thebs pa dang / bshang sgo cung zad bsdams shing / steng rlung sna gnyis nas dal bus grangs shing / lte ba'i 'og tu mnan/ 'og sgo sngar las dam par bsdams te/ rlung kha sbyar ci thub bzung zhing / mi thub na thog mar 'og sgo dal bus glod/ steng rlung sna gnyis nas shed chung bar btang zhing / gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam la mnyam par gzhag go /de dag gis mnyam par gzhag pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis bstan nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la brgyad las/ dang po dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyi ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum pa/ /sha ni puk+ka si ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng 'phros/

rang gi zhal nas/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs thugs kha'i aṃ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung / yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi gsang gnas nas zhugs te/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ltar 'khor bas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyai rdo rjer byas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul/ sngags phreng dang 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byung / rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs rang gi zhal brgyad/ yum/ lha mo brgyad sems can thams cad yi dam du gyur pa rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu bzlas par bsam/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dha ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha te ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kan+dha ri ṇi/ adh+ma ta kru ra tsit+ta ye/ ar+dhen+tu daṃṣ+ṭ+ri ṇi/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sat+pa sā ga rā na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kan/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trun/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a aṃ badz+ra nai rat+na āt+ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ā aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bzung / kha rlangs phog par byas te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

sdig sgrib dam tshig gi nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / nad gdon bar chad zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas te phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod de brtan par byas/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo mi bsdu na/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal las khang la thim/ de lha mo brgyad la thim/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ 'gro ba thams cad kye rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag kol+la/ phun sum tshogs pa/ rigs su skye/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /bza' btung byed pa'i tshe oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī/ kha zas dang btung ba bdud rtsir dran zhing / rang yab yum du gsal ba'i snying khar bla ma yi dam/ lto bar chos skyong rigs drug bsams nas/ de dag la 'bul ba'i tshul gyis zhen pa med par longs spyod/ lnga pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang yab yum yang snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / nā da'i bar du bsdus te ci yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa 'od gsal gyi ngang la gnyid log go /drug pa rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab te/ bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed par bya'o snyam pa'i 'du shes gsum ldan dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes 'dzin med kyi rgyas btab par bya'o/ /bdun pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang la nyal na/ snga dro skad cig gis rang yab yum gyi skur dran pa dang / snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su ldang /

rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor byas na/ rang yab yum thig ler zhu ba'i ngang la nyal nas/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe mtshams bzhis bskul bar bsam zhing / rje btsun snying rjes yid bzhengs shig sogs rang gi brjod cing / yab yum gyi skur bzhengs/ snod bcud de ltar ro/ /brgyad pa mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rgyas par gzhan du gsal/ bsdus na/ yi dam dang / mgon po lcam dral sogs la 'bul tshul/ kho bos logs su bris pa ltar bya zhing / de'i rjes su 'byung po nyer bzhi la/ gtor ma 'bul na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hā ho hṛ/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan/ mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs kyi steng ma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar/ oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug byang shar du briṅki ri ti/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du gzhon nu kārti ka/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gri thod 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba/ bar gyi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ hūm̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su thugs rdo rje/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gri thod 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'og gi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la ā dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/

thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gri thod 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba/ kun yang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku rdo rje'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ steng gi lha tshogs thams cad lha chen brgyad la bsdus/ thugs rdo rje las 'od 'phros pas sa steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdu/ gsung rdo rje las 'od 'phros pas sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la bsdus/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs dang / rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+rīṃ bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las steng ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ bar ma rnams la mi skyod pa/ 'og ma rnams la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra nī ri ti sogs chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa las 'od 'phros gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kā ya/ wāk+ka tsit+ta/ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhuta/ bah+ni/ ba u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ bap+pa/ tā ma ba ta la/ aṭ+ṭa/ sap+pa/ swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhu dza/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ am+ba/ kadz+dza/ sap+pa/ sa dhā/ khin+ta/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya t+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ sogs sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ oṃ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /ces dang / kol+la sogs rdo rje'i glu dang / phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis/

rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam bya/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba sogs dang / gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor de thams cad kyang bstan zin to/ /de ltar mthu stobs dbang phyug man ngag bzhin/ /grub pa'i 'khor lo sgyur rgyal sa skya pa'i/ /lam srol thun mong ma yin nyams blangs na/ /spyod pas mtshams sbyar rdo rje'i sa thob nges/ /'dir 'bad dge ba kun+da'i phung po ltar/ /rnam par dkar ba gang de rigs drug gi/ /sems can thams cad snying po'i don rtogs nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rnyed gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sngon chos kyi rgyal po sa skya paṇ+ṭi ta khu dbon gyi lugs gnyis yangs pa'i khrims la mnga' bsgyur ba/ dpon chen gzhon nu dbang phyug dang / 'od zer seng ge sogs kyi gdung 'dzin pa shrī na ren+d+ra gu ru rat+na bha dras nye bar bskul ba'i zhal ngor bgyis te/ dpal sa skya'i lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa mo glang gi lo snron gyi zla ba phyi ma'i dmar cha dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la byas 'gyur rdo rje brag rdzong du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zla ba grags pa'o// //na mo badz+ra nai rāt+mā yai/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje nas rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad de/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dang nang skor gyi phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi dang phyi skor gyi mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi sdom pa rdo rje bdag med ma/ spyi bo dang spyi gtsug tu rdo rje ma/ rna ba g.yas pa dang / ltag par gsang ba'i dkar mo/ rna ba g.yon pa dang / smin ma'i dbus su chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ mig gnyis dang / phrag pa gnyis su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

mchan khung gnyis dang nu ma gnyis su puk+ka sī/ lte ba dang sna rtser sha ba ri/ kha dang mgrin par tsaṇ+ṭa lī/ snying kha dang 'doms bar du ḍoṃ bi ni/ mtshan ma dang bshang lam du gau rī/ brla gnyis dang byin pa gnyis su tsau rī/ sor mo bcu drug dang bol gong gnyis su be ta lī/ mthe bong bzhi dang pus mo gnyis su ghasma rī/ snying kha'i phyi skor gyi mdun dang / g.yas su mkha' spyod ma/ rgyab dang g.yon du sa spyod ma/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūm̐ aṃ gi rnam pa can/ phyogs bzhir hūm̐ ring po bzhi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pū dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi pre gṛ sai su na si ma ku'i dbyibs su gnas pa rnams na rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi nang du gnas pa'i khams rnams ni bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung rnams ni snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ sku bzhi rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga sogs brjod/ dbang lha spyan drang / mchod bstod/ dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung blang rjes/ phyi nang gi lha rnams rigs bdag 'dra bar byed cing / sngon dang rjes kyi ngag 'don rnams kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i bdag med ma'i phyi dkyil yan lag drug pa ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang las dang po rnams kyi yum gyis lus dkyil sgom tshul ngag 'don/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gsung ji lta bar/ sa skya pa skad gnyis smra ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs grol ba'i thig le/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
